description:
Touch-Driven Performance Meets Wireless Freedom

The Snom D895M takes the D8xx series to a new level, featuring a high-resolution 8-inch touchscreen that enables particularly intuitive operation and brilliant, detailed displays. The generous display area makes navigating through contacts, functions and call information much easier, thereby ensuring more efficient workflows in day-to-day office life. 56 SmartLabel touch buttons (14 per page) with multi-coloured LEDs offer maximum flexibility for custom configuration and provide clear, visual guidance – even in demanding usage scenarios.


The integrated DECT handset significantly expands the desk phone’s functionality and allows for cordless use with a range of up to 50 metres. Combined with integrated Bluetooth 5.0 and dual-band Wi-Fi, the Snom D895M meets all the requirements of modern workplace connectivity and supports seamless working in hybrid and dynamic environments. Hearing aid compatibility also ensures barrier-free use and underlines its claim to universal applicability.

At the same time, the Snom D895M sets new standards in sustainability and hygiene: as with most Snom desk phones, the housing is made from eco-friendly, recycled plastic, and the antibacterial surface offers additional protection in everyday use. Overall, the Snom D895M combines advanced technology, wireless freedom and sophisticated design in an elegant, professional desk phone that meets the highest standards.

The Snom D895M – designed for today, ready for tomorrow.
key_feature:
• Cordless DECT receiver
  • High-resolution, tiltable 8" IPS colour display with touch function (1,280 x 800 pixels)
  • Built-in Wi-Fi for wireless network connectivity
  • Built-in Bluetooth for headset connectivity
  • 2x USB 2.0 type A ports
  • 2x Gigabit Ethernet ports
  • Expandable with D8C expansion modules
  • Anti-bacterial housing
  • Power over Ethernet (PoE)
  • Remote maintenance possible via SRAPS Device Manager
